Martial Arts (×2) is learned one Form at a time; each Form is its own Skill. Martial Arts Attacks are ROF2, ignore half armor and deal Brawling damage by BODY. Every Form has two Special Moves, and all Forms share Recovery.

Special Moves

  • Iaijutsu: You rolled Initiative, with an unequipped Heavy or Very Heavy melee weapon in reach. At the start of combat, DV15: top of the Initiative order this Round. You must spend an Action to attack with that weapon, which is equipped after the attack.
  • Sheathe/Unsheathe: A Very Heavy melee weapon in both hands; you dodged every melee attack since your last Turn. DV15: enter a stance. Your next melee attack also inflicts Torn Muscle, or make it an Aimed Shot to the head for Brain Injury instead. It ends at the end of your Turn or after a melee attack.

Special Move resolution: DEX + Form Skill + 1d10 vs the target's DEX + Evasion + 1d10, or the DV listed. Special Moves can't be Aimed Shots unless they say so. "Once per Turn" means once per your Turn.

Recovery (shared): when you use Get Up, beat DV13 and it costs no Action. Not with a Broken or Dismembered Leg.
